Surat: a Gujarat gold jewellery export maker files for an IPO on 188% revenue growth.

સુરત: ગુજરાતની સોનાની ઝવેરાત નિકાસકાર કંપનીએ 188% આવક વૃદ્ધિ સાથે IPO માટે અરજી કરી.

Tanvi Exports, which makes about 8% of Gujarat's gold jewellery exports, has filed its DRHP with SEBI. Revenue rose from Rs137.46 crore in FY24 to Rs1,139.94 crore in FY26.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Photo: Sri Veerabadra Jewellers, CC0, Wikimedia Commons.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs12,824/g, 22K Rs11,756/g, silver Rs1,86,711/kg -- 2 Oct tape close.
